# Product-of-exponentials model from the robot's joint geometry in spec().
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
AXES=np.array(spec['arm']['axis'],float)
JOINTS=np.array(spec['arm']['position_m'],float)
EE0=np.array(spec['arm']['end_effector']['position_m'],float)

def fk(q, point=EE0):
    T=np.eye(4)
    for angle,axis,pivot in zip(q,AXES,JOINTS):
        R=Rotation.from_rotvec(axis*angle).as_matrix()
        J=np.eye(4);J[:3,:3]=R;J[:3,3]=pivot-R@pivot
        T=T@J
    return T[:3,:3]@point+T[:3,3],T[:3,:3]

def solve_ik(q0,target,tool_down=True,starts=20):
    lower=np.array([-20,-2.24,-20,-2.57,-20,-2.09,-20],float)
    upper=-lower
    q0=np.array(q0,float)
    best=None
    def residual(q):
        p,R=fk(q)
        err=list(6*(p-np.array(target)))
        if tool_down: err+=list(2.0*(R[:,2]-np.array([0,0,-1])))
        err+=list(0.025*(q-q0))
        return err
    rng=np.random.default_rng(42)
    for i in range(starts):
        seed=q0 if i==0 else np.clip(q0+rng.normal(0,1.2,7),lower+1e-4,upper-1e-4)
        sol=least_squares(residual,seed,bounds=(lower,upper),max_nfev=300)
        cost=np.linalg.norm(residual(sol.x))
        if best is None or cost<best[0]:best=(cost,sol.x)
    return best

def solve_pose(q0,target,direction,starts=30):
    lower=np.array([-20,-2.24,-20,-2.57,-20,-2.09,-20],float)
    upper=-lower
    q0=np.array(q0,float);target=np.array(target,float);direction=np.array(direction,float);direction/=np.linalg.norm(direction)
    def residual(q):
        p,R=fk(q)
        return list(8*(p-target))+list(2.2*(R[:,2]-direction))+list(.012*(q-q0))
    rng=np.random.default_rng(12);best=None
    for i in range(starts):
        seed=q0 if i==0 else np.clip(q0+rng.normal(0,.8,7),lower+1e-4,upper-1e-4)
        sol=least_squares(residual,seed,bounds=(lower,upper),max_nfev=250)
        cost=np.linalg.norm(residual(sol.x))
        if best is None or cost<best[0]:best=(cost,sol.x)
    return best
PY

def ballistic_now(goal_z=.18):
    s=np.array(r.get_obs(cameras=[],video='none').meta['proprio']['now'],float)
    q=s[6:13];qd=s[13:20];p,R=fk(q)
    J=np.column_stack([(fk(q+np.eye(7)[i]*1e-5)[0]-p)/1e-5 for i in range(7)])
    yaw=s[2];rot=np.array([[np.cos(yaw),-np.sin(yaw),0],[np.sin(yaw),np.cos(yaw),0],[0,0,1]])
    P=rot@p+np.array([s[0],s[1],0]);V=rot@(J@qd)+np.array([s[3],s[4],0]);V[:2]+=s[5]*np.array([-P[1]+s[1],P[0]-s[0]])
    t=(V[2]+np.sqrt(V[2]**2+2*9.81*(P[2]-goal_z)))/9.81
    hit=P+V*t+np.array([0,0,-.5*9.81*t*t])
    print('ballistic','steps',r.status()['control_steps'],'q',np.round(q,3),'qd',np.round(qd,3),'p',np.round(P,3),'v',np.round(V,3),'t',round(t,3),'hit',np.round(hit,3),'gripper',s[20],flush=True)
